# Coyotiv

> Coyotiv is a technology education company operating in two lines of business: corporate AI/technology training for organizations, and Coyotiv School, an individual full-stack software engineering bootcamp based in Berlin, Germany.

Coyotiv designs and delivers AI and technology training for companies — from executive briefings to multi-week hands-on programs for engineering teams — and separately runs Coyotiv School, a live, project-based software engineering program (flagship: 14-week Full-Time Full-Stack Software Engineering) that teaches people to think and build like modern software engineers in the AI era.

## Corporate training (Turkish)
- [Kurumsal Eğitimler](https://school.coyotiv.com/index.html): Corporate AI and technology training landing page — programs, formats, case studies, trainers, FAQ, contact.

## Corporate training (English)
- [Enterprise AI Training](https://school.coyotiv.com/en.html): English version of the corporate training page.

## Individual bootcamp (Turkish)
- [Coyotiv Yazılım Okulu](https://school.coyotiv.com/yazilim-okulu.html): Turkish-language individual software engineering bootcamp page — programs, curriculum, instructors, reviews, FAQ.

## Individual bootcamp (English)
- [Coyotiv School](https://school.coyotiv.com/yazilim-okulu-en.html): English version of the individual bootcamp page, centered on the flagship 14-week Full-Time program.

## Blog (Turkish)
- [Coyotiv Blog](https://school.coyotiv.com/blog.html): Turkish-language articles on AI engineering, software engineering careers, and learning science, written by Coyotiv's trainers and team.

## Blog (English)
